title: HVAC Alarm and Unauthorized Remote Session — Room 114

fields.organization: Marston County Health Department — Environmental Health
fields.location: Room 114, Storage Room, Ellery Health Center
fields.summary: The West District Office reported a smoke alarm activation in Room 114 at 09:48. Fire marshal confirmed no fire, but the HVAC control HMI logged a sudden CO2 spike at 09:51. The system was not in maintenance mode. Logs show a remote session from MCHD-FS01 to the HVAC controller at 09:49. No EH staff authorized this access. The office remains closed for air quality testing; staff are requesting guidance on return.

findings.notes: No fire or heat source detected; false alarm confirmed by fire marshal
Sudden CO2 increase from 420 to 980 ppm at 09:51; no scheduled maintenance
Session from MCHD-FS01 (10.72.1.62) to HVAC-CTRL-01 at 09:49; no authorization in EH access log
Not inspected on-site due to air quality protocols
No visible system damage or tampering
Camera 114-01 showed no unauthorized person in room
Report received via interdepartmental email (FIR-2026-1022-0091)

actionsTaken: Notified County IT via secure line at 10:49
Closed Room 114 to staff pending air quality clearance
Reviewed access logs from MCHD-FS01 and HVAC controller
recommendations: Verify remote session origin and user identity via IT logs
Conduct full cybersecurity review of HVAC control system
Hold all public advisories on air quality until IT confirms system integrity
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_20261021-104902 (HVAC HMI screen with CO2 spike), IMG_20261021-104905 (MCHD-FS01 session log from 09:49)

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The HVAC alarm and session were not caused by a physical event. The team should validate the remote session with IT and not issue any public advisories until system integrity is confirmed.
